summary: First test run for Bharat Fashion OS. Backend: 20/20 pytest passing (after one small fix). Frontend: All critical flows verified end-to-end (home, stores list, store detail, shop, product detail, add to bag, cart, merchant login, dashboard, AI Studio demo enhance, merchant products, protected redirect). Demo merchant login works. AI copy via Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns valid JSON. AI image enhance now returns 200 with curated fallback after fix.

minor.issue: Originally raised 500 — ImageContent(file_content_base64=...) was wrong kwarg in emergentintegrations. Real arg is image_base64. ALSO: ImageContent() construction was OUTSIDE the try/except, so any SDK error bypassed the curated fallback. Fixed by renaming kwarg and moving UserMessage construction inside try block.

Sets store_id = user['sub'] (merchant id) instead of a real store doc id. Means newly created merchant products won't appear on any /store/{id} page since no matching store doc exists. Cosmetic for demo but worth wiring to a real store record.
Returns hardcoded mock revenue/repeat/conversion regardless of merchant — acknowledged in spec as Phase 1 mock.

integration_issues.issue: Inputs (Full name, Phone, House no, Pincode) lack data-testid AND name attributes — only placeholders. Validation does fire ('Please fill address' toast) so behavior is correct, but automated tests and accessibility tooling can't reliably target fields.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes (checkout-name, checkout-phone, checkout-line1, checkout-pincode, place-order) to Checkout.jsx form inputs/button so automated tests can fill the form and complete the order flow.
Consider giving each merchant a real store document on registration so merchant-created products surface in /stores/:id flows.
(Optional) Replace hardcoded merchant dashboard numbers with values aggregated from orders/products collections.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.enhance_product_image previously instantiated ImageContent OUTSIDE the try/except — any SDK construction error bypassed the curated fallback and surfaced as HTTP 500. Wrap all third-party SDK calls (constructors + send_message) inside try/except for graceful degradation.
server.py POST /merchant/products uses user['sub'] as store_id. Should look up / create a stores doc tied to the merchant.
Pydantic EmailStr is strict — readme already documents avoiding .test/.example TLDs. Consider catching ValidationError and returning a friendly message at the API boundary.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 flows; checkout place-order blocked only by missing testids in test, not by app bug)

seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded on startup: 5 categories, 6 stores, 12 products. Tests also created TEST_AutoProduct under demo merchant and a registration user test_<ts>@bharat-test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers all 14 endpoints. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v. AI image enhance fix already applied. Remaining gap is data-testid on Checkout inputs — once added, re-run the playwright flow to confirm /order/:id tracking page renders with order ID + 4-step timeline.
rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/merchant/ai/enhance-image returned 500. RCA: emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ImageContent constructor signature is image_base64:str, but code passed file_content_base64. TypeError raised at construction-time, outside the try/except in enhance_product_image, so HTTPException(500) was raised in server.py rather than returning the curated fallback. Fix: (1) rename kwarg to image_base64; (2) move UserMessage(...) construction inside the try block so any SDK error correctly falls through to the demo fallback. Verified by re-running test_ai_enhance_image — now 200 with source='gemini-nano-banana' or 'fallback'.
